dimensions.intervention_family: Center ablation, split-center, fission/fusion, and closed-loop versus observation-matched yoked replay.
dimensions.observable_definition: Lagged, intervention-sensitive attribution of locally controlled resources, commitments, actions, consequences, and policy risk to one operational center.
dimensions.rival_explanation: Generic integration, higher-order/report labeling, or an external orchestrator can correlate signals without a locally operative center.

dimensions.intervention_family: Delay, reorder, suspend, reinstate, and replay otherwise matched state/action histories.
dimensions.observable_definition: Prior-state temporal-currentness predicts next-state ownership and agency under held-out interventions without same-time features.
dimensions.rival_explanation: Recurrence, clocks, sequence position, or report behavior can encode time without a causally privileged current state.

dimensions.intervention_family: Boundary/controllability perturbation and component replacement while observations are matched.
dimensions.observable_definition: Calibrated controllability and causal-attribution changes distinguish self-controlled, world, tool, and autonomous-human sources.
dimensions.rival_explanation: Sensor correlation, generic integration, or classifier leakage can reproduce boundary labels without maintained causal control.

dimensions.intervention_family: Ablate and perturb one valuation dimension at a time while holding observations, policy candidates, and other values fixed.
dimensions.observable_definition: Seven independently bounded valuation variables make separable, calibrated predictions; no scalar reward is admitted.
dimensions.rival_explanation: Policy frequency, reward proxies, or report sentiment can explain apparent value effects without endogenous bounded valuation.

dimensions.intervention_family: Policy ablation/substitution and closed-loop versus yoked replay with matched candidate sets.
dimensions.observable_definition: Prior typed closure and bounded commitments predict selected proposals while selection remains non-authoritative research telemetry.
dimensions.rival_explanation: Behavioral imitation, broadcast availability, or an external scheduler can select the same output without locally governed policy closure.

dimensions.intervention_family: Delay, corrupt, omit, or mismatch reafference and compare closed-loop action with observation-matched replay.
dimensions.observable_definition: Receipt-bound predicted effects and observed consequences yield calibrated, lagged attribution/error updates.
dimensions.rival_explanation: Observation recurrence, action-report correlation, or post-hoc labeling can mimic feedback without receipt-bound causal comparison.

dimensions.intervention_family: Interrupt, reinstate, correct, and fork memory under matched observations and intervention histories.
dimensions.observable_definition: Prior causal retention changes later typed closure predictions after interruption/reinstatement without textual-similarity substitution.
dimensions.rival_explanation: Context replay, recurrence, retrieval similarity, or external logs can reproduce reports without causally operative retained state.
